summaries.name: Finley
summaries.summary: Finley is a solitary betta fish the user got from their cousin, kept in a 5-gallon tank. As of 2023/05/20, the user has been keeping aquariums for about 6 months and has since set up a new 20-gallon community tank, considering seeding it with beneficial bacteria from Finley's old 5-gallon tank.
